core_obligations: Directedness: images of G + H under G+H -> F give a coherent submodule containing both (cited sub-quotient lemma), so the system is directed (proof lines 4081-4091).

Transport: the presentation X = [U/R] with the cited coherent-presentation lemma identifies QCoh and Coh with the groupoid modules, reducing to the Groupoids in Spaces colimit-coherent lemma; the closing paragraph verifies its hypotheses (U and R Noetherian, s,t smooth qsqc) (proof lines 4094-4122).
proof_roadmap: Show the coherent submodules form a directed system.
Transport to the groupoid presentation and check the cited lemma's hypotheses.
difficulty_reason: Directedness of the system of coherent submodules is verified directly (the image of G plus H is coherent and contains both); the statement is then transported along the groupoid presentation QCoh(X) = QCoh(U,R,s,t,c) to the cited Groupoids in Spaces lemma, whose hypotheses are checked in a final paragraph (U Noetherian from the smooth-local definition, s,t smooth quasi-separated quasi-compact, R Noetherian).
